title: Contact Us | RH Business Club
metaDescription: Contact RH Business Club for product questions, order support, payment help, returns, and more. We're here to help.

hero.title: We're Here to Help.
hero.subtitle: Contact
hero.description: Have a question about a product, an order, delivery, payment, or something else?
body: Send us a message. Our team is here to help make your RH Business Club experience easier.

contactForm.title: Send Us a Message
contactForm.subtitle: Let's talk
contactForm.description: Fill in the form and we'll get back to you. Fields marked with an asterisk are required.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.help: We'll only use this to reply to your message.

fields.label: Phone Number

fields.placeholder: What can we help you with?

contactForm.footnote: We use your details only to respond to this enquiry.

productRequest.title: Looking for Something We Don't Have?
productRequest.subtitle: Product Request
productRequest.description: Can't find a product you're looking for? We're listening.
body: Use our Product Request feature to tell us what you'd like to see in the Club. Your request could help shape what we offer next.

companyInfo.responseTime: We reply within one business day

suggestions.title: Checking on an order?
suggestions.description: Your order status and expected delivery window are on your Orders page — often faster than waiting for a reply.

suggestions.title: About delivery
suggestions.description: Orders within Dhaka typically arrive in 2–3 days, and other parts of Bangladesh within 4–7 days.

suggestions.title: Returns and refunds
suggestions.description: Include your order number and a photo if the item arrived damaged — it helps us resolve things in one reply.

suggestions.title: Payment help
suggestions.description: We accept Cash on Delivery across Bangladesh along with common mobile financial services.

suggestions.title: Looking for a specific product?
suggestions.description: If it isn't in the catalogue yet, a Product Request goes straight to the team that decides what we stock next.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: You can view your order status from your account after placing an order. Every order shows its current status and expected delivery window.

faqs.question: How can I request a product?
faqs.answer: Use our Product Request feature and tell us what you're looking for. Requests also help shape what we stock next.

faqs.question: Do you deliver across Bangladesh?
faqs.answer: Yes. RH Business Club is focused on providing reliable delivery across Bangladesh, with Cash on Delivery available nationwide.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: Send us a message through this page or use the support channels listed above. We reply within one business day.
